title: Kenton and the unrealized music school idea
summary: Herman tried for years to get Kenton to open a music school staffed by former players, but Kenton always said later.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Yes. He talked to you a number of times, didn't he?
Have you had very many conferences with people like Stan?

No, the only other -- we used to have periodical meetings, he and I, which was no more than a social thing. But I tried to convince him for a number of years, but he never would go for it, to open a music school out here, and utilize all of our former players who live here, for instance.
And we could offer a curricula that no else was able to. And he always agreed that it was a great idea, but for much later. I kept saying, 'when later?'
And it's unfortunate. I'm sorry we blew it.
Yeah, it would have been a good thing.
